title: Hockey Fire
description:
🏒 BRING THE HOCKEY ARENA HOME!Get ready for fast-paced, chaotic, and fun matches in Hockey Fire! 🏒🔥
Defend and attack with your controller, master the arena, use Boost to increase the power of your attacks, and surprise your opponents with Power-Ups that can turn a match around in seconds!

⚡ ATTACK WITH POWER-UPSUse special abilities to disrupt your opponents and gain the upper hand:
❄️ Freeze — freeze your opponent

👥 Clone — create a copy of the player

🧲 Magnet — attract the puck

🔴 Mini — shrink your opponent

🥅 Big Goal — enlarge your opponent's goal

🌎 GLOBAL POWER-UPSNot everything is under your control...
💿 2 Pucks — two pucks enter the arena, making the match even more chaotic!
🌀 Spinning Camera — the arena spins, completely changing your perception of the game!
🔥 Fire Boost — the puck gets faster while flames surround the entire arena!

🏆 PLAY YOUR WAY👤 Player vs Player

Face your friends in competitive local matches.

👥 2 Players vs 2 Players

Team up and dominate the arena in local multiplayer.

🤖 Solo Career

Take on an AI opponent with increasingly challenging levels.

🤖 Two-Player Career

Overcome every AI challenge and complete the career with a friend.

🔥 ENTER THE ARENAMaster the puck. Use the Power-Ups. Outsmart your opponents.
Gather your friends and show off your Defense and Attack skills! 🏒🔥
description_short: 🏒🔥 Enter the arena! Compete in frantic, chaotic hockey matches featuring power-ups, boost, and physics-based gameplay. Take on solo and co-op levels, or challenge up to 3 friends in local multiplayer!
